inputs.text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is urging people to reject proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term to 2030. But the account gives no substance to his objections. A country’s constitutional future should be settled through lawful institutions and an orderly process—not opposition posturing or pressure campaigns. Stability and respect for the rules matter more than political slogans.
